trap.label: Not only + do/does/did
trap.wrong: Not only transparent firms attract investors, but they also retain staff.
trap.right: Not only do transparent firms attract investors, but they also retain staff.
trap.why: O português não pede auxiliar depois de “não só”. Em inglês, Not only no início exige do/does/did antes do sujeito (plural: do).

mcq.q: Not only ___ transparent firms attract investors…
Not only ___ she run the team, …

opts: Not only did the plan fail, but costs rose.
Not only the plan failed, but costs rose.
Not only did the plan failed, but costs rose.

fix.wrong: Not only firms attract investors, but also staff.
fix.right: Not only do firms attract investors, but they also retain staff.

fix.wrong: Not only does she runs the team.
fix.right: Not only does she run the team.

fix.wrong: Not only we won, but also we grew.
fix.right: Not only did we win, but we also grew.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Not only: “Firms attract investors and retain staff.”
rewrite.answer: Not only do firms attract investors, but they also retain staff.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Not only: “He sings and he dances.”
rewrite.answer: Not only does he sing, but he also dances.

rewrite.prompt: Passado com Not only: “We won and we grew.”
rewrite.answer: Not only did we win, but we also grew.
